messages:
maya: Quick sync — planning a lightweight webinar + launch posts tied to the free credits experiment. Need decisions on: 1) routing inbound leads from the webinar, 2) two launch post variants for social, 3) which prompt templates go in the starter pack, and 4) measurement tags. Can we scope this in <30m? :timer_clock:
jon: +1. My agenda: webinar timing, CTAs, event gating (email vs token), and post-event nurture. Propose Wed 3pm PT.
li: Wed 3pm PT works. For routing: suggest immediate funnel -> onboarding flow A for attendees, flow B for registrants who didn’t attend. We should tag by source so sales gets a hot list.
sam: Drafted two social captions — A (straight value): "Ship LLM features faster with predictable inference. Join our webinar + grab free credits." B (story-led): "How Acme cut inference cost 3x — demo + free credits. Save your seat." Which do we A/B on LinkedIn vs Twitter? :thinking_face:
kevin: We'll A/B by channel. LinkedIn: B performs better historically; Twitter: A. Also adding UTM params: `?utm_source=social&utm_medium=launchpost&utm_campaign=webinar630` — make sure the landing page reads utm_campaign to set cohort cookie.
maya: Nice. Sam — can you post both variants as copy + 1 image option each into the Notion page? Link: https://redwood.notional/webinar-launch (placeholder).
sam: Done — pasted copies and image suggestions. Also added two prompt templates for the starter pack: `sales-email-gen` and `summarize-convo` in the doc. Short examples inline: `prompt: "Summarize this customer chat into 3 bullets"`.
li: For routing specifics: Use `webinar_attendee=true` cookie and `source=webinar` tag. Then in routing rules: if attendee && usage>10 => assign to sales-hot; else if registrant && attended=false => send 3-email nurture over 7 days.
jon: For measurement: primary metric = 7-day activation (first 5 API calls). Secondary = webinar->signup conversion. Need to add tracking event `webinar_credited` when we issue free credits.
kevin: I’ll add `webinar_credited` to the analytics schema and wire it to the cohort dashboard. Also creating a shorttime alert for large credit redemptions.
maya: Ops question: credit cadence — do we issue full credits on signup or only after webinar attendance? We discussed gating to prevent gaming.
sam: Recommend issue 50% on signup, remainder after attendance + first API call. Reduces ghost signups.
li: Agree. Implementation note: backend needs an idempotent claim endpoint `/api/credits/claim?user_id=...&event=webinar` and a TTL for pending credits.
kevin: I'll file a quick task in JIRA and tag eng-oncall for the endpoint.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Launchpad: Webinar — Inference in Production" Wed 15:00 PT. Invitees: maya, jon, li, sam, kevin.
jon: Promotion cadence: 3 posts before event (10d, 4d, 1d), 1 Post-day-of, and 2 post-webinar followups with CTAs to claim credits. Add audiences: org admins, ML engs, product managers.
maya: Agree. Sam — can you craft the 10d and 4d posts with slightly different hooks (benchmark narrative vs cost narrative) and put them into the scheduler by EOD Friday?
sam: On it. Will also include short testimonial snippet for the benchmark narrative: "cut inference cost by 3x, 40% latency improvement" — we'll flag as anonymized.
li: Last check — landing page should include 1) clear credit mechanics, 2) quick start prompt templates, and 3) a CTA that triggers the cohort cookie. Can design review tomorrow morning?
maya: Design review 9:30am tomorrow. I'll invite product-design.
jon: One more — webinar script needs 2 quick demos: 1) latency/throughput dashboard, 2) prompt template to result flow. Sam, can you write the demo bullet points?
sam: Yep, sketching bullets now.
kevin: I'll ensure tracking tags are live for the demo interactions so we can instrument conversion heatmaps.
maya: Great progress. Action items: Sam — copy + images to Notion by EOD; Kevin — analytics schema + JIRA task; Li — routing rules doc; Jon — final agenda + demo bullets; Design review 9:30am tomorrow. Back here after design sign-off. :rocket:
